title: Moraine Lake, Lake Louise, Banff highlights -8-13pax
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Note: Moraine lake entry start from June 1st-Oct 14 instead of Johnston canyon.

Enjoy exclusive summer access to Moraine Lake with our small group tour (8–10 guests). Since private vehicles are not allowed and access requires advance shuttle arrangements, we take care of everything so you can relax and enjoy the experience.
Discover the most iconic and breathtaking locations in Banff National Park in a comfortable small group of just 8–10 people, allowing for a more personal experience.
Take in stunning mountain viewpoints and keep an eye out for wildlife such as bears, mountain goats, elk, deer, and bighorn sheep—all observed safely from a distance in our small group setting.

Enjoy free time in Banff Town for lunch and shopping, with the flexibility that comes from traveling.

Travel comfortably in a modern, air-conditioned Van. Family-friendly tour designed for small groups.Ideal for traveler with limited time in Calgary or Canmore.
